title: Leading negative Wick defect is necessary for stationary descent

necessity.fixed_coupling: Fix g>0 independently of the cutoff N.
necessity.descent_hypothesis: Q_N[psi_N]<=lambda_N^statG-epsilon N^4 for fixed epsilon>0 along a cutoff subsequence.
necessity.leading_scale: For fixed g>0, every leading descent therefore requires D_N=-Omega(N^4).
necessity.positive_prices: The negative defect must dominate both stationary-Gaussian displacement A_N and non-Gaussian score residual R_(Omega,N)/4.
necessity.scope_guard: At fixed g>0, a negative defect, even of leading order, is necessary rather than sufficient; no realizing family or unrestricted coefficient is supplied.
